tasks.title: Fix escaped configuration paths
tasks.instruction: The get_path helper handles ordinary dotted dictionary paths, but escaped dots and list traversal are broken. Implement backslash escaping for the next path character, support non-negative decimal list indexes, reject empty segments and dangling escapes with ValueError, and raise TypeError when a list segment is not an index or traversal reaches a scalar. A supplied default must be returned only for a missing dictionary key or an out-of-range list index. Preserve the public get_path(data, path, default=MISSING) API.

tasks.title: Add Retry-After handling to retry policy
tasks.instruction: Complete parse_retry_after and integrate it into next_delay. Retry-After accepts either non-negative integer seconds or an RFC 7231 HTTP date. Date calculations must use the injected timezone-aware now value and past dates produce zero. Missing, malformed, negative, or timezone-naive values are ignored. next_delay keeps exponential backoff, uses the larger of backoff and a valid Retry-After delay, and then applies the cap. Reject negative attempts, base delays, or caps with ValueError. Keep all calculations deterministic and do not read the system clock when now is supplied.

tasks.title: Refactor duplicated event summaries
tasks.instruction: Refactor event_summary so text and JSON rendering share one aggregation path. Add a frozen Summary dataclass and summarize(events), which must consume any iterable exactly once without mutating input events. total counts every event, ok and failed count only those exact statuses, unknown statuses count only toward total, and a missing duration_ms contributes zero. Reject bool or negative/non-integer duration_ms values with ValueError. Preserve the exact existing text and compact sorted JSON output formats, and have both render functions delegate to summarize.

tasks.title: Debug incremental NDJSON decoding
tasks.instruction: Fix NDJSONDecoder's incremental behavior and add focused regression coverage where useful. feed(chunk) must emit only complete newline-terminated JSON values while retaining a partial record, including when CRLF is split across chunks. Blank or whitespace-only lines are ignored but still advance the one-based physical line number. finalize() parses one final unterminated nonblank record exactly once; repeated finalize calls return an empty list. Malformed JSON raises NDJSONError with the physical line number and original decoder message. Feeding after finalization raises RuntimeError.

tasks.title: Implement an async TTL cache
tasks.instruction: Implement async_cache.AsyncTTLCache. Its constructor accepts a non-negative ttl_seconds and an optional injected clock. get_or_load(key, loader) must cache successful values until the TTL expires, provide one shared in-flight loader per key, and ensure cancellation of one waiter does not cancel another. A failed loader must neither cache a value nor strand the key. invalidate(key) removes a cached value and clear() removes all cached values. Keep the public class and methods usable with normal hashable keys and awaitable zero-argument loaders.

tasks.title: Aggregate streaming CSV input
tasks.instruction: Implement streaming_csv.aggregate_csv using Python's standard csv support and one pass over an iterable of CSV lines. Return frozen MalformedRow and CSVSummary values. CSVSummary must expose total_rows, accepted_rows, rejected_rows, deterministic totals as sorted (category, Decimal) pairs, and a bounded tuple of malformed-row reports. Require unique headers containing group_column and amount_column. Reject wrong-width rows, blank categories, and non-finite or invalid Decimal amounts while continuing; max_errors only bounds saved reports, not rejected_rows. Do not mutate or reread input.

tasks.title: Build a sync and async retry decorator
tasks.instruction: Implement retry_decorator.retry as a decorator factory for both ordinary and async callables. attempts is the total number of calls and must be positive. Retry only the configured non-empty tuple of exception classes, re-raising the final original exception. Wait after each retryable failure using delay * backoff**failure_index and an injectable sleeper; async functions accept an awaitable sleeper. Validate bad parameters without reading clocks or sleeping. Preserve wrapped callable metadata.

tasks.title: Produce stable dependency ordering
tasks.instruction: Implement toposort.stable_toposort for a mapping of node to dependencies. Dependencies must precede dependents while preserving mapping order and each dependency iterable's order where possible. Do not mutate graph inputs or require reusable dependency iterables. Raise MissingDependencyError with node and dependency attributes when an edge names no node. Raise DependencyCycleError with a closed cycle tuple in traversal order when a cycle exists.

tasks.title: Map async work with a concurrency bound
tasks.instruction: Implement bounded_map.bounded_map(function, items, *, limit). Invoke the awaitable function for iterable items with at most limit active calls and return results in input order. limit must be a positive integer. On any worker failure, stop starting later items, cancel and await outstanding workers, then re-raise the original error. If the caller cancels bounded_map, it must likewise cancel and await outstanding workers before propagating cancellation.

tasks.title: Deep-merge immutable TypeScript configuration
tasks.instruction: Implement config_merge.mergeConfig in erasable TypeScript for Node's built-in type stripping. Export a MergeOptions interface and a generic mergeConfig declaration. Deep-merge plain objects without mutating or retaining mutable references to either input. Arrays replace by default or concatenate with { array: 'concat' }. Undefined override properties are ignored by default, including properties absent from the base; { undefined: 'overwrite' } retains an explicit undefined property. Reject unsupported option values. Use no package installation, compiler, enum, namespace, or non-erasable TypeScript syntax.

tasks.title: Implement a typed reentrant event emitter
tasks.instruction: Implement event_emitter.TypedEventEmitter in erasable TypeScript. Export type declarations for event maps and listeners and make the emitter generic over event argument tuples. on and once return an unsubscribe function; off removes one most-recent matching registration and returns whether it did so. emit returns whether there were listeners. Emission uses a registration snapshot: additions wait for a later emit, removals before a listener's turn skip it, and once listeners are removed before invocation so reentrant emits cannot invoke them twice.

Patterns start with / and support literal segments, :named parameters, and one final *named wildcard. Match decoded path segments, return null for an unmatched or badly encoded input path, and reject invalid patterns. Resolve ambiguity by preferring literal over parameter over wildcard at the earliest differing segment; preserve input order on ties. Return decoded parameters and a Map query multimap retaining repeated values in encounter order.

tasks.title: Run an ordered bounded promise pool
tasks.instruction: Implement promise_pool.promisePool in erasable TypeScript and export its generic PoolWorker type. The worker receives item, index, and an AbortSignal. Enforce a positive safe-integer concurrency limit, run no more than that many workers, and return results in input order. On the first failure, abort the shared signal, stop launching items, wait for already-started workers to settle, and reject with that original failure.

tasks.title: Implement an LRU cache with TTL
tasks.instruction: Implement lru_ttl.LruTtlCache in erasable TypeScript with an exported LruTtlOptions interface and generic class declaration. The constructor takes positive integer capacity, non-negative ttlMs, and an optional injected now clock. get promotes a live entry; has does not promote; expired entries are absent at their exact expiry time. set overwrites and refreshes an entry, evicts the least-recently-used live entry when full, and returns this. Provide delete, clear, and a size getter that excludes expired entries.
